title: macOS Asia-market apps: WeChat/WeCom/QQ/DingTalk/Feishu/Lark, Baidu/Ali cloud, NetEase, Tencent Meeting, WPS, CJK IMEs, LINE/KakaoTalk, Naver Whale, Huawei/Samsung residuals
description: Regenerable caches, WebKit/Electron Chromium subdirs, and logs for major East-Asian desktop apps under $HOME on macOS. Never message DBs, chat Backup folders, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Cookies, Preferences, account key material, or full Application Support trees that hold offline conversations.
scope: Asia-market messengers, collaboration, cloud drive clients, music/dict, office, input methods, regional browsers, phone-bridge residuals. Electron template only (Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache, Dawn*, Service Worker, blob_storage, Crashpad, logs). WebKit process caches under ~/Library/WebKit/<bundle>.
notes: Caches/logs only. WeChat/WeCom/QQ offline Message/*.db, Backup/, and full container Application Support account trees are never-touch (would destroy chat history).
Feishu/Lark Electron userData may appear as LarkShell, Lark, LarkInternational, or Feishu under Application Support; only Chromium cache leaves, not sdk_storage login state as a whole wipe.
Baidu Netdisk and aDrive: Electron Cache/* only; do not wipe whole baidunetdisk/aDrive trees (may hold offline indexes/login).
Input methods (Sogou/Baidu/iFlytek): cache and temp only; never delete Input Methods app bundles under /Library/Input Methods or user dict/personal phrase DBs if path is ambiguous.
Naver Whale is Chromium-based; prefer Cache/Code Cache/GPUCache leaves under Library/Caches and Application Support, not whole profile.
Samsung DeX has no first-party macOS app; Smart Switch Mac is the closest residual. Report-only note for DeX.
Huawei HiSuite Mac: caches/logs only; never user HiSuite backup archives of phone data.
Close listed apps before clean. Prefer min_age_days on media-heavy messenger caches.
sources: Homebrew cask zap trash: wechat, wechatwork, qq, dingtalk, feishu, lark, baidunetdisk, adrive, neteasemusic, youdaodict, youdaonote, tencent-meeting, wpsoffice, wpsoffice-cn, sogouinput, baiduinput, naver-whale, tencent-lemon
WeChat forensic layout: Containers/com.tencent.xinWeChat/Data/Library/Caches and Application Support (messages under AS only, not auto-delete)
LINE Mac cache: Containers/jp.naver.line.mac nested Cache (Qiita / community cleaners)
Feishu/Lark help: Application Support/LarkShell and Lark/LarkInternational cache vs sdk_storage
Chromium/Electron standard userData cache leaf names
never_touch_notes: Never $HOME/Library/Containers/com.tencent.xinWeChat/Data/Library/Application Support/com.tencent.xinWeChat (Message DBs, Backup, Avatar as whole tree)
Never whole WeCom/QQ Application Support or Group Containers holding chat stores
Never Feishu/Lark sdk_storage whole wipe as default (login state); cache leaves only
Never cloud-drive download/sync roots the user configured outside Library
Never HiSuite or Smart Switch phone backup folders under Documents or user-chosen backup paths
Never $HOME/Documents, Desktop, Downloads, Keychains, Mail, Messages

rules.name: WeChat Mac container and Library caches
rules.description: WeChat (com.tencent.xinWeChat) sandboxed Caches and top-level Library/Caches only. Not Application Support message/Backup trees.
rules.notes: Homebrew wechat zap lists Caches + Containers. Message DBs live under Application Support/com.tencent.xinWeChat/<ver>/<uuid>/Message; never that tree.

rules.name: WeCom / WeChat Work container caches
rules.description: 企业微信 (com.tencent.WeWorkMac) sandbox Library/Caches and related helper containers. Not full IPC/account stores.
rules.notes: Homebrew wechatwork zap is container-heavy; only Caches/Logs contents here. Close WeCom first.

rules.name: QQ Mac caches and WebKit process data
rules.description: QQNT (com.tencent.qq) Library/Caches, container Caches, and WebKit site data cache. Not chat databases in Group Containers.
rules.notes: WebKit path from Homebrew qq zap. Do not wipe Group Containers/FN2V63AD2J.com.tencent chat stores.

rules.name: DingTalk caches, WebKit, and Application Support temps
rules.description: 钉钉 (com.alibaba.DingTalkMac) Library/Caches, installer caches, WebKit, and regenerable logs under DingTalkMac support.
rules.notes: Homebrew dingtalk zap. Prefer Electron/WebKit leaves under Application Support/DingTalkMac; not whole support tree (session).

rules.name: Feishu and Lark Electron Chromium caches
rules.description: ByteDance Feishu (CN) and Lark Suite (intl) Electron caches under Application Support name variants plus com.electron.lark Library/Caches.
rules.notes: Homebrew feishu/lark zap only lists Library/Caches; community/docs use LarkShell/Lark/LarkInternational. Never whole sdk_storage (login).

rules.name: Baidu Netdisk caches and Electron leaves
rules.description: 百度网盘 (com.baidu.BaiduNetdisk-mac) Library/Caches, crashreporter, and Application Support Electron cache leaves.
rules.notes: Homebrew baidunetdisk. Not whole Application Support/baidunetdisk (login/offline index). Not user download folders.

rules.name: Alibaba aDrive Electron caches
rules.description: 阿里云盘 aDrive (com.alicloud.smartdrive) Electron cache leaves under Application Support/aDrive.
rules.notes: Homebrew adrive zap lists whole Application Support/aDrive; ppduster only takes Chromium cache leaves.

rules.name: NetEase Cloud Music caches and WebKit
rules.description: 网易云音乐 (com.netease.163music) caches, WebKit, and container caches. Not user-downloaded music libraries.
rules.notes: Homebrew neteasemusic. Never $HOME/Music or app-configured download directories for purchased/offline tracks.

rules.name: NetEase Youdao Dictionary and Youdao Note caches
rules.description: 有道词典 and 有道云笔记 caches, WebKit, Electron leaves for note client. Not notebook content stores as whole wipe.
rules.notes: Homebrew youdaodict/youdaonote. Note Electron app names vary by locale; cache leaves only.

rules.name: Tencent Meeting caches, containers, WebKit
rules.description: 腾讯会议 (com.tencent.meeting) Library/Caches, container Caches/Logs, WebKit. Not meeting recordings in user Documents/Movies.
rules.notes: Homebrew tencent-meeting. Never user-chosen recording export dirs.

rules.name: WPS Office CN and global container caches
rules.description: Kingsoft WPS (com.kingsoft.wpsoffice.mac / .global) sandbox Caches and Logs. Not user documents under container Documents.
rules.notes: Homebrew wpsoffice / wpsoffice-cn. Close WPS first. Never document roots.

rules.name: Sogou input method caches
rules.description: 搜狗输入法 user caches and regenerable Application Support cache panels. Not /Library/Input Methods/SogouInput.app.
rules.notes: Homebrew sogouinput zap. EmojiPanel is regenerable skins/emoji cache. Prefer not wiping InputMethod personal dict if present under same tree without age filter; contents under listed cache roots only.

rules.name: Baidu input method caches
rules.description: 百度输入法 user Library caches and support temps. Not /Library/Input Methods/BaiduIM.app bundle.
rules.notes: Homebrew baiduinput uninstalls system Input Method only; user cache bundle IDs vary by version. Never personal phrase DB if co-located outside Cache.

rules.name: iFlytek input method caches
rules.description: 讯飞输入法 macOS user caches and logs. Not Input Methods app bundle under /Library.
rules.notes: First macOS IME released 2023; bundle IDs vary. Cache leaves only. Confirm on live host if present.

rules.name: LINE Mac nested container caches
rules.description: LINE (jp.naver.line.mac) nested Cache trees and Library/Caches. Not Sticker packs as required offline assets if user prefers keep (sticker re-download is safe).
rules.notes: Documented nested path Data/Library/Containers/jp.naver.line/Data/Cache. In-app Settings > Data also clears cache. Do not wipe chat DB stores.

rules.name: KakaoTalk Mac container caches
rules.description: KakaoTalk (com.kakao.KakaoTalkMac) sandbox Library/Caches. Not full container Application Support chat stores.
rules.notes: Community cleaners and agents use Containers/.../Library/Caches. Close KakaoTalk first.

rules.name: Naver Whale browser caches
rules.description: Whale Chromium caches under Library/Caches and Application Support user data Cache leaves. Not Cookies/Login Data/History.
rules.notes: Homebrew naver-whale. Default off medium like other browser HTTP caches. Close Whale first.

rules.name: Samsung Smart Switch Mac caches (DeX note)
rules.description: Smart Switch for Mac caches/logs. Samsung DeX has no first-party macOS residual app tree.
rules.notes: DeX is phone/TV feature, not a Mac app. Smart Switch is the common Samsung residual on macOS. Never phone backup archives under user-chosen backup folders.

rules.name: Samsung DeX on macOS (report-only)
rules.description: No first-party Samsung DeX desktop client residual paths on macOS; DeX is device-side.
native_hints: No stable ~/Library DeX app bundle; skip inventing com.samsung.dex paths
If Smart Switch is installed, use asia-samsung-smart-switch-cache only
rules.notes: Explicit null result for DeX native Mac caches.

rules.name: Huawei HiSuite Mac caches and logs
rules.description: HiSuite phone manager caches/logs residuals. Not HiSuite phone backup archives.
rules.notes: HiSuite Mac supports media/file/backup. Never delete user backup payloads; cache/log only.

rules.name: Tencent Lemon cleaner self-caches and logs
rules.description: Tencent Lemon (Asia-market cleaner) own caches and log files, not third-party wipe lists.
rules.notes: Homebrew tencent-lemon zap. Optional Asia residual often co-installed with Tencent apps.
